description:
In this compilation episode of Drain the Oceans from National Geographic, the team examines relics of Pearl Harbor, The Alamo, and The War of 1812 that lie on the seabed. With emerging technologies and new discoveries, can archaeologists shed light on these pivotal attacks that shaped America? 

Drain the Oceans Compilation | S6 E5 "Battleground America"

0:00 Introduction
1:13 The Lost Chesapeake Flotilla (War of 1812)
5:39 Investigating the "Turtle Shell Wreck"
10:41 Identifying the Flagship & Missing Fleet
16:30 The Pass Cavallo Arms Shipwreck
24:34 Solving the Texas Gun-Running Mystery
29:37 The Sinking of the USS Arizona
33:50 Mapping the Pearl Harbor Wreck
38:10 Exploring Inside the USS Arizona
